subject: Animation
title: South Korean Animation Industry
description: A micro-lesson that makes South Korean Animation Industry usable.

hook.text: South Korea animates a huge portion of the shows Americans watch, but few viewers realize it.

buildup.text: Studios like DR Movie and Studio Mir animate The Simpsons, Avatar, and many other major Western shows.

discovery.text: Korean studios offer high-quality animation at lower costs, making them essential partners for American productions.

twist.text: Despite doing the actual animation work, Korean studios rarely receive public credit or brand recognition.

climax.text: South Korea is one of the world's biggest animation producers — and one of its least recognized.

punchline.text: Your favorite American cartoons were probably drawn in Seoul.

quiz.question: What role does South Korea play in global animation production?
options: It only produces original Korean animated shows
Korean studios animate many major American shows like The Simpsons, often without public credit
It focuses exclusively on anime-style animation

details.summary: South Korea is the world's hidden animation powerhouse, outsourcing production for The Simpsons, Family Guy, and dozens of Western shows while building its own original industry with series like Noblesse and Solo Leveling.
details.whyItMatters: Korean studios animate many of the world's most popular shows but receive little credit. Understanding Korea's dual role — as both outsource provider and original creator — reveals animation's truly global production chain.
takeaways: Korean studios animate much of Western television including The Simpsons
South Korea is building an original animation industry alongside outsourcing
The webtoon-to-animation pipeline is uniquely Korean and growing fast

faq.question: How much Western animation is produced in South Korea?
faq.answer: A large percentage of American animated TV is animated in Korean studios. The Simpsons, Family Guy, Avatar, and many others outsource to Korean studios for cost-effective, high-quality production work.

faq.question: How is Korea's original animation industry developing?
faq.answer: Korea's massive webtoon industry provides a pipeline of proven stories for adaptation. Series like Solo Leveling and Tower of God began as Korean webtoons before becoming internationally successful animated shows.
